changes.before: Medium shot at a Thames river landing on 2 September 1666, one unmistakably adult resident in a plain wool coat and knee breeches lifts one wooden household chest over the low gunwale of a broad flat cargo lighter moored beside the bank; the chest is visibly entering the boat, with a few plain boxes already on its flat deck, overcast daylight and simple brick riverside houses behind
changes.after: Medium close shot aboard a flat wooden cargo lighter on the Thames in 1666: one grey-haired middle-aged resident with a lined adult face, broad shoulders, a dark wool doublet and a white linen collar bends to lower a single wooden household chest over the low side rail onto the bare deck; both hands hold the chest, while river water and pale overcast sky fill the background, full frame without black bars
